predecessors.name: Stem Duchy of Bavaria
predecessors.text: the Carantanian march: 'the adjacent eastern territory beyond the Koralpe range on to the Mur River, Mürz and Enns rivers'

successors.name: Duchy of Styria
successors.text: the Carantanian march: 'the adjacent eastern territory beyond the Koralpe range on to the Mur River, Mürz and Enns rivers'

ledger.x: c. 970: the Carantanian march exists. 'Created sometime before 970, it was broken off the larger March of Carinthia'; the lands had been reconquered up to the Lafnitz after the Lechfeld (955). Dated 'before 970' by the page, so 970 is the last safe year. [Reviewer eu-08-x, 2026-10-25: counterpart corrected from…
Before 970: the march is a Bavarian march.
976: 'it was transferred to the jurisdiction of the newly created Duchy of Carinthia'.
976: the march passes to Carinthia (same sentence).
1035: Adalbero of Eppenstein is deposed and Arnold of Wels-Lambach becomes margrave (1035-1055); the page dates his Carinthian enfeoffment 1011/12.
1042-43: Henry III conquers the land east of the Mur.
1056: the Otakar (Traungau) margraves begin: Ottokar I (1056-1075), first mentioned as 'Margraves of Steyr' in 1074.

wars.name: Battle of Ménfő
wars.outcome: Henry III conquered the land east of the Mur up to Pitten and the Leitha in 1042/43 and defeated the Hungarian forces at the Battle of Ménfő in 1044.

certainty.note: The page names rivers and ranges (Koralpe, Mur, Mürz, Enns, Lafnitz, Leitha), no treaty line.
